selection: Existing Arland benchmark pair, plus the first capture in run order from each v1 scene variant. No quality-based selection. Motion: complete first successful path using the corrected explicit quality preset, plus its first paired frame. Material room: first complete run with the final EXR-first generator and 4096-sample reference settings. Lighting: test-view and stress-outside selected in the versioned plan before training; source, model output and reference for each, all reviewed. Earlier and final fit image bytes match. Frozen-model motion: both complete 32-frame sequences; frame 16 selected in the committed plan for stills and posters. No performance/quality selection. Color lookup: every image from the initial rejected-priority batch and all seven separately declared priority-19 controls, including every off repeat. Full-size review of all nine; no quality-based selection.
